verification_questions.question: Does bridge/server.py contain a FastAPI application instance?
Does GET /api/health return {status: 'ok', drawers: <int>} with HTTP 200?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, health() calls tool_status() and returns the drawer count

verification_questions.question: Does CORS middleware allow chrome-extension:// and moz-extension:// origins?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, via allow_origin_regex matching both patterns

verification_questions.question: Does CORS reject non-extension origins?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, test_cors_rejects_random_origin verifies no CORS header for https://evil.com

verification_questions.question: Does bridge/requirements.txt list all required dependencies?
verification_questions.expected: Yes: mempalace, fastapi, uvicorn, pytest, httpx

verification_questions.question: Do Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml match the spec?
verification_questions.expected: Yes: python:3.11-slim base, port 21517, mempalace-data volume, MEMORYMARK_PORT env var
